text:
alex: heads up — A/B shows new quantized reranker (q4x) losing ~0.02 overall MRR in prod for group B. offline eval on our eval harness shows +0.4 MRR. discrepancy seems concentrated on queries returning docs with HTML metadata (tables, 
, lots of tags).
maria: that's weird. can you paste an example query + top doc that fails?
alex: yep. one example below (redacted):
```json
{
  "query": "how to format code in markdown?",
  "doc_id": "doc-789",
  "title": "Formatting Code in MD",
  "body_html": "
function foo() { return 42; }
See table below
...
",
  "body_text": "function foo() { return 42; } See table below ..."
}
```
prod ranking uses body_text (stripped) but our offline harness used body_html -> tokenized differently. that could explain shifts.
chris: also note quantization nudges logits — small score deltas can flip ties. our prod tie-breaker uses `created_at` fallback vs harness which stable-sorts by candidate id. if html keeps extra tokens it changes score gaps near 0.
sam: concrete next steps: 1) reproduce offline with the exact prod preprocessing pipeline (strip_html -> collapse whitespace -> same tokenizer version) 2) run harness with prod tiebreaker semantics 3) run paired bootstrap on html-heavy slice. i can run 1+2 now. command i use: 
```
./eval_harness --models reranker:q4x --cohort html_heavy_slice.jsonl --preproc=prod_strip_html --tie-break=created_at --metrics ndcg,mrr --out tmp/result.json
```
maria: @sam thanks. also check tokenizer diffs — we bumped tokenizer v2.1 in staging. if prod is still v2.0 token boundaries for `
` content differ a lot.
eval-bot: CI job started for `reranker/q4x/html-repro` — https://ci.internal/6112233445/jobs/23 :building_construction:
chris: if this repros, quick temporary fix is to canonicalize doc fields in the model-serving layer (always prefer body_text if present) — low risk and can roll back.
alex: confirmed: when sam ran with prod preproc + tie-break we see -0.01 MRR (closer to prod). when we force body_text only, offline and prod align within noise.
maria: can we add a unit test to the onboard checklist so future model brings run with both html/raw_text variants? small patch: add golden sample with `
`/`` and assert stable ordering across quant and fp32.
sam: filing PR #1287 with the harness change + a synthetic HTML heavy cohort. i'll attach results.
achris: long-term we should standardize tie-breaker semantics across harness and prod (and document in onboarding). also add an eval slice: `html-with-code` to our regression monitoring.
alex: plan then: hotfix to canonicalize to body_text in serving (rollback ready), add harness tests + slice, update onboarding checklist. i'll own the hotfix, @maria pls own the harness tests, @chris update docs. thanks all :thumbsup:
